name: searchonair
description: Search on Air: research tools over Turkish legal, tax and health sources

plugins.name: searchonair-lawyer
plugins.description: Semantic and keyword search over 11M+ Turkish court decisions (Court of Cassation, Council of State, regional and first-instance courts, Constitutional Court), full-text reading and answers with exact case citations. Requires a Search on Air token.

plugins.name: searchonair-accounting
plugins.description: Search Turkish tax laws, Revenue Administration (GİB) communiqués, circulars and rulings, and accounting standards; read full texts and get answers that cite the exact article. Requires a Search on Air token.

plugins.name: searchonair-health
plugins.description: Search Turkish health legislation, the Social Security Institution's Health Implementation Communiqué (SUT), patient-rights regulations and official public health guidance, with answers that cite the exact article. Not medical advice. Requires a Search on Air token.
